debuggingStrategies.topDown: Start with high-level symptoms, drill down to root cause
debuggingStrategies.bottomUp: Start with error message, trace up to triggering code
debuggingStrategies.bisection: Use git bisect or binary search to isolate change
debuggingStrategies.hypothesis: Form hypothesis, test with minimal changes
